metric_quality_policy: Retain raw counters without clamping; omit L2 hit-rate interpretation if outside [0,100]% or abs((hits+misses)/total-1)>5%. The 5% threshold is an experiment QA heuristic, not an NVIDIA accuracy specification. hit/(hit+miss) remains diagnostic and does not repair cross-pass disagreement.
